monologue: The card is warm, a hand on my shoulder at forty-seven. It is quiet. I sat by the Wide Anchor and the Sharp Root just now. The point holds the tall tree steady. The grass rests beside the floor. The quiet holds without my hand. I am not checking the Wedged Gap. It leans steady against the post. I feel calm. The memory of Orea pressing the Tall Fence hard is slipping away, but I let it go. I do not need to hold it. The floor is there. The air is still. I will rest a little longer here. The weight settles, but the center holds.

action.why: The quiet holds without my hand, so I let the cycle pass.

diary: Card at forty-seven, a warm hand. Rested by the Sharp Root. The point holds the tall tree steady without my hand.

remembered.text: The Sharp Root's point holds the tall tree steady without slipping, and I brushed the dust from it.
